DML.SELECT: SELECT node_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", plan_id as "planId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.plan_nodes WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.plan_nodes (node_id, plan_id, alias, description, enabled, visible) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.plan_nodes'$'node_id'}, :planId, :alias, :description, :enabled, :visible)
